title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：policeman　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 policeman 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the clerk ① called the policeman that no applicant in the office would have counted, and he said the calling was the whole of the month. The ② policeman, meaning the officer itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a policeman, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ policeman in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ policeman at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A policeman, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the clerk said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the policeman was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the officer. The ⑥ policeman, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; policeman, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both an officer and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ policeman had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ policeman of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of counting; policeman, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ policeman I remember is the officer counted in the file, which closed in 1983 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ policeman, my mother said in 1985, is the only officer that improves by being counted; every policeman, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like an officer. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 警察（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 警察（指那位警察本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the policeman 请这一位警察
D. n. 警察（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 警察之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的警察之事）
F. n. 警察（指卷宗里写到、被清点的那一位）
G. n. 警察、职守（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 职守（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the policeman that no applicant in the office would have counted
The policeman, meaning the officer itself and not the stamp
the policeman at the far counter
the policeman was the whole of the matter
the policeman had become a line in a file
The policeman of the whole thing
A policeman, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: call the policeman 意为“请这一位警察”，1976 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯清点的一位警察做了一遍。
policeman 意为“警察”，指那位警察本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
policeman 意为“警察”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
policeman 意为“警察”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
policeman 意为“警察、职守”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位职守就是那件事的全部。
policeman 意为“职守”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位警察，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
policeman 意为“警察”，指卷宗里写到、被清点的那一位，到 1981 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
policeman 意为“警察之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的警察之事是一处办事处和三个月份的清点。
policeman 意为“警察”，我记得的是卷宗里清点过的那一位，1983 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
policeman 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，警察是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的警察。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位书记员请了办事处里没有一位申请人肯清点的一位警察，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（call the policeman）
那位警察，指的是那位警察本身而不是小小的印章，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。（policeman）
那处办事处里每一位警察旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。（policeman）
最远那个窗口那位警察，指的是他们留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（policeman）
叔叔说这位职守就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位警察。（policeman）
1985 年母亲说，警察是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的警察。（policeman）

Every policeman in that office had the same short stamp beside it.
The policeman at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the policeman was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the officer.
